verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an official MCP server and plugin for AI coding assistants. Its docs say these let users manage voice agent testing and observability from the development environment. A CLI, an SDK, and a public OpenAPI spec cover runs and call data. However, the evidence never explicitly shows an agent querying traces, metric results, or eval results through the MCP server or API for debugging, so the story is only partly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of MCP/API tools for reading traces and metric/eval results, read/query endpoints for observability data, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app

citations.quote: Whether you're using Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code, you can manage your voice agent testing and observability directly from your development environment.
Install Cekura Skills and MCP so your AI assistant can design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations.
Manage agents, scenarios, runs, and call data from your terminal
Programmatic access to Cekura — sync and async clients for application code
